overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator. Also corrected direction on out-parameters (doc arrow column shows them as command outputs, not inputs) which the mechanical parser had defaulted to 'in'. Also stripped a stray '**' footnote-marker artifact from the scraped return type (it is plain Boolean).

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, object below is the name of the form object (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: The OBJECT Get focus rectangle invisible command returns the status of the visibility option for the focus rectangle of the object(s) designated by the object and * parameters for the current process .

platformConstraints.note: Hide focus rectangle option is supported.
Supported when Fluent UI is enabled.
The option has no effect in classic Windows UI.
